newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks end mixed ahead of long weekend.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks end mixed ahead of long weekend.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended mixed in quiet trading ahead of the country's three-day holiday.
Medellin's IBOMED general price index slipped 0.15 percent to close at 13,450.36 on volume of 653 million pesos, while Bogota's IBB edged up 0.07 percent to 863.19.
Volume in Bogota was well below average, with just 625 million pesos in shares traded. Monday is a national holiday and all banks and financial markets will be closed.
Movers in Bogota included heavily traded Banco de Colombia, which rose 0.45 percent to 439 pesos a share.

The bank has slipped steadily in recent trading on a lack of information and uncertainty about its announced intention to form a strategic partnership with Spain's Banco Central Hispano. But brokers said market players clearly do not want to it slip below 438 pesos a share.

Banco Ganadero's common shares also closed higher, ending up 0.38 percent at 262 pesos per share. Banco de Bogota fell 1.80 percent to end at 5,990 pesos a share, however, and cement maker Cementos Argos dropped 0.27 percent to close at 5,400.
In Medellin, brokers said foreign fund buying contributed to a 0.54 rise in Sudamericana de Seguros, the insurance giant owned by the powerful Sindicato Antioqueno conglomerate.
Cementos Caribe, another conglomerate holding, rose 0.11 percent to close at 4,355 pesos a share.
Banco de Colombia, matching its gains in Bogota, rose 0.34 percent in Medellin to end at 439 pesos a share.
